post.description: Date-specific, read-only Airbnb London, Vrbo Orlando, Agoda Bangkok, Trip.com Tokyo and Booking.com Paris stay observations. One matching platform and documented source_region per request; two adults, no children/infants/pets. Currency GBP for Airbnb; USD for Vrbo, Agoda, Trip.com and Booking.com. Stays of 1–30 nights, limit 1–50. Costs 50 credits. No booking guarantee, reviews, full availability calendar, cursor or additional filters.
